title: More Queries to Array...
statementMd:
You've got an array, consisting of $*n*$ integers: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Your task is to quickly run the queries of two types:

1. Assign value $*x*$ to all elements from $*l*$ to $*r*$ inclusive. After such query the values of the elements of array $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$ become equal to $*x*$.
2. Calculate and print sum ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/920d5e77b57e41992ceefa42465edf8cfc006a39.png), where $*k*$ doesn't exceed $5$. As the value of the sum can be rather large, you should print it modulo $1000000007 (10^{9} + 7)$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$), showing, how many numbers are in the array and the number of queries, correspondingly. The second line contains $*n*$ integers: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the initial values of the array elements.

Then $*m*$ queries follow, one per line:

1. The assign query has the following format: "![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2ef693fd11e9e29c50f180848ea668ed6d33b22.png)", ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*; 0 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$).
2. The query to calculate the sum has the following format: "![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6a63948f42b361ef379406ad9a679d1da1aee76b.png)", ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*; 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 5$).

All numbers in the input are integers.

## Output

For each query to calculate the sum print an integer — the required sum modulo $1000000007 (10^{9} + 7)$.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的数组：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。你的任务是快速处理以下两种查询：

1. 将从 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$（包括两端）的所有元素赋值为 $*x*$。执行该查询后，数组元素 $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$ 的值都将变为 $*x*$。
2. 计算并输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/920d5e77b57e41992ceefa42465edf8cfc006a39.png)，其中 $*k*$ 不超过 $5$。由于该和的值可能很大，你需要输出其对 $1000000007 (10^{9} + 7)$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示数组中元素的个数和查询的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示数组元素的初始值。

接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含一个查询：

1. 赋值查询的格式如下："![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2ef693fd11e9e29c50f180848ea668ed6d33b22.png)"（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$；$0 ≤ *x* ≤ 10^{9}$）。
2. 计算和的查询格式如下："![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6a63948f42b361ef379406ad9a679d1da1aee76b.png)"（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$；$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 5$）。

输入中的所有数均为整数。

## 输出格式

对于每个计算和的查询，输出一个整数，即所求的和对 $1000000007 (10^{9} + 7)$ 取模后的结果。
